title: The Guardian's Real Form
summary: Inside the Temporal Clocktower, Ha-Jun confronts Chronos-Malek's time-distortion illusions, witnessing fragments of his stolen childhood and alternate destinies.

panels.shot: inside the clocktower: floating spiral staircases of frozen seconds
panels.action: A majestic, mind-bending cathedral where hundreds of brass spiral staircases twist through mid-air like DNA strands.
panels.prose_en: A majestic, mind-bending cathedral where hundreds of brass spiral staircases twist through mid-air like DNA strands.
panels.prose_hi: Ek rajsi, man-mugdh karne wala cathedral jahan saikadon pital ki sarpil sidhiyan dna strand ki tarah madhya hawa mein ghumti han.

panels.shot: golden sand falling upwards toward the ceiling in gravity inversion
panels.action: Golden sand streams upward from the floor toward the ceiling in perfect reverse gravity, twinkling like stardust.
panels.prose_en: Golden sand streams upward from the floor toward the ceiling in perfect reverse gravity, twinkling like stardust.
panels.prose_hi: Sunhari ret bilkul vipreet gurutvakarshan mein farsh se chhat ki or upar ki or bahti hai, stardust ki tarah timtimati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking up the central staircase carrying tae-jun securely
panels.action: Ha-Jun ascends the floating brass steps; Min-Jae and Baek guard his flank with weapons sweeping the shadows.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun ascends the floating brass steps; Min-Jae and Baek guard his flank with weapons sweeping the shadows.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun tairti hui pital ki sidhiyon par chadhta hai; min-je aur bak hathiyaron ke saath uske parshva bhag ki raksha karte hain aur chhaya ko paar karte han.

panels.shot: a sudden temporal ripple washes over the staircase
panels.action: A wave of shimmering silver chronal distortion sweeps through the room, making reality stutter like a scratched film reel.
panels.prose_en: A wave of shimmering silver chronal distortion sweeps through the room, making reality stutter like a scratched film reel.
panels.prose_hi: Chamchamati silver cronal vikriti ki ek lahar kamre mein ghumti hai, jisse vastavikta ek kharonch wali film reel ki tarah haklane lagti hai.

panels.shot: min-jae and baek freezing mid-motion like statues
panels.action: Min-Jae and Captain Baek freeze completely mid-stride, their boots half-lifted, eyes locked in stationary stillness.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae! Captain Baek! They are frozen in the flow of time!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae and Captain Baek freeze completely mid-stride, their boots half-lifted, eyes locked in stationary stillness.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je aur captain bak puri tarah se beech mein hi sthir ho gaye, unke jute aadhe uthe hue the, aankhen sthir shanti mein band thin.

panels.shot: ha-jun remaining mobile thanks to kuro's mythic feather shield
panels.action: The Mythic Feather on Tae-Jun's chest and the Crown on Ha-Jun's brow emit a joint spherical barrier, insulating them from time-stop.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The Sovereign's will cannot be frozen by mortal time. Keep moving forward.

panels.prose_en: The Mythic Feather on Tae-Jun's chest and the Crown on Ha-Jun's brow emit a joint spherical barrier, insulating them from time-stop.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ki chhati par pauranik pankh aur Ha-Jun ki bhaunh par mukut ek sanyukt golakar avrodh ka utsarjan karte han, jo unhen samay-rukne se bachata hai.

panels.shot: temporal illusion 1: ha-jun as an ordinary salaryman in modern seoul
panels.action: In a floating pane of chronal glass, Ha-Jun sees himself at 25—an ordinary office worker in a suit, tired, riding the subway.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar mere parents na marte... Agar demon bloodline na hota... Main aisa hota?

panels.prose_en: In a floating pane of chronal glass, Ha-Jun sees himself at 25—an ordinary office worker in a suit, tired, riding the subway.
panels.prose_hi: Cronal glass ke tairte falak men, Ha-Jun khud ko 25 saal ka dekhta hai - suit pahane ek sadharan karyalay karmchari, thaka hua, metro ki sawari karta hua.

panels.shot: illusion 1 detail: ordinary ha-jun smiling with tae-jun at a dinner table
panels.action: In the glass, ordinary Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun are eating dinner with their living parents, laughing happily.
panels.prose_en: In the glass, ordinary Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun are eating dinner with their living parents, laughing happily.
panels.prose_hi: Gilas men, sadharan Ha-Jun aur Tae-Jun apne jeevit mata-pita ke saath khushi se hanste hue raat ka khana kha rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching toward the glass his heart aching with longing
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers hover inches from the warm, golden image; a single tear traces down his cheek.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingers hover inches from the warm, golden image; a single tear traces down his cheek.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki ungaliyan garm, sunhari chhavi se kuch inch door ghumti han; uske gaal par ek aansu ka nishan hai.

panels.shot: temporal illusion 2: dark future where ha-jun becomes a tyrant
panels.action: The glass fractures into a second dark reflection: Ha-Jun on a throne of skulls, cold crimson eyes, burning Earth to cinder.
panels.prose_en: The glass fractures into a second dark reflection: Ha-Jun on a throne of skulls, cold crimson eyes, burning Earth to cinder.
panels.prose_hi: Kanch ek dusre andhere chhaya mein toot jata hai: khopadiyon ke sinhasan par Ha-Jun, thandi lal rang ki aankhen, jalti hui prithvi.

panels.shot: dark ha-jun in the mirror laughing with hollow madness
panels.action: The dark reflection sneers: 'Surrender to the blood, boy! Power is the only truth in this pathetic universe!'

dialogue.speaker: dark_hajun
dialogue.text: Embrace the slaughter! Why protect weaklings who threw stones at you?

panels.prose_en: The dark reflection sneers: 'Surrender to the blood, boy! Power is the only truth in this pathetic universe!'.
panels.prose_hi: Andhera chhaya vyangya karta hai: 'khoon ke samne samarpan karo, ladke! is dayniya brahmand mein shakti hi ekmatra satya hai!'

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing sanguine fang and shattering both mirrors
panels.action: With a clean, decisive sweep of his blood katana, Ha-Jun shatters both illusion panes into a thousand harmless shards.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main na kisi jhoothe sapne mein jiyunga... Aur na hi kisi zalim monster banunga.

panels.prose_en: With a clean, decisive sweep of his blood katana, Ha-Jun shatters both illusion panes into a thousand harmless shards.
panels.prose_hi: Apne khoon katana ke ek saf, nirnayak prahar ke sath, Ha-Jun ne bhram ke donon kinaron ko ek hajar hanirahit tukdon mein tod diya.

panels.shot: the glass shards dissolving into golden mist
panels.action: The fragments dissolve into sparkling mist; Ha-Jun's eyes burn with absolute lucidity and self-knowledge.
panels.prose_en: The fragments dissolve into sparkling mist; Ha-Jun's eyes burn with absolute lucidity and self-knowledge.
panels.prose_hi: Tukde chamchamati dhundh mein ghul jaate han; Ha-Jun ki aankhen purna spashtata aur aatm-gyan se jalti han.

panels.shot: at the apex of the tower: the sanctuary of the hourglass
panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches the summit platform—a circular amphitheater surrounded by twelve massive golden clock faces.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches the summit platform—a circular amphitheater surrounded by twelve massive golden clock faces.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shikhar manch par pahunchta hai - barah vishal sunhare ghadi chehron se ghira ek golakar rangbhumi.

panels.shot: suspended in the center: the hourglass of eternal abyss
panels.action: A two-meter-tall ornate hourglass of blackened abyssal gold, containing glowing sand that shifts from royal violet to bright gold.
panels.prose_en: A two-meter-tall ornate hourglass of blackened abyssal gold, containing glowing sand that shifts from royal violet to bright gold.
panels.prose_hi: Kale gahre sone ka do meter lamba alankrit ghantaghar, jisme chamakti ret hoti hai jo shahi baingani se chamkile sone mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: the keeper of the hourglass materializing from the ceiling: chronos-malek
panels.action: Descending from the center ceiling is Chronos-Malek—a four-faced entity wrapped in golden clock hands and silver gears.

dialogue.speaker: chronos
dialogue.text: Mortal of the Sovereign line. You have survived the trials of alternate destinies.

panels.prose_en: Descending from the center ceiling is Chronos-Malek—a four-faced entity wrapped in golden clock hands and silver gears.
panels.prose_hi: Kendra ki chhat se utarti hui cronos-malek hai - sunhare ghadi ki suiyon aur chandi ke gear mein lipati ek char-mukhi ikai.

panels.shot: chronos-malek four faces rotating displaying past, present, future, and void
panels.action: Four porcelain masks rotate on its mechanical neck: a smiling child, a stoic warrior, a decaying skull, and a black void hole.
panels.prose_en: Four porcelain masks rotate on its mechanical neck: a smiling child, a stoic warrior, a decaying skull, and a black void hole.
panels.prose_hi: Char chini mitti ke mukhaute iski yantrik gardan par ghumte han: ek muskurata hua baccha, ek kattar yoddha, ek sadti hui khopri, aur ek kala shunya chhed.

panels.shot: chronos-malek demanding the price of the hourglass
panels.action: Chronos-Malek: 'The Hourglass can rewind any wound. But it drinks human memory as its fuel. Are you prepared to forget?'

dialogue.speaker: chronos
dialogue.text: For every year of life you restore to your brother, a season of your own childhood shall be consumed forever.

panels.prose_en: Chronos-Malek: 'The Hourglass can rewind any wound. But it drinks human memory as its fuel. Are you prepared to forget?'.
panels.prose_hi: Cronos-malek: 'ovarglas kisi bhi ghav ko theek kar sakta hai. lekin yah manav smriti ko apne indhan ke roop mein peeta hai. kya aap bhulne ke liye taiyar han?'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down at tae-jun face resting on his shoulder
panels.action: Ha-Jun glances at Tae-Jun's sleeping face; he remembers Tae-Jun giving up his youth, his freedom, and his body.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun ne mere liye saat saal tak narak saha... Aur main kuch memories ke liye ro ro kar rukunga?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun glances at Tae-Jun's sleeping face; he remembers Tae-Jun giving up his youth, his freedom, and his body.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki nazar Tae-Jun ke sote hue chehre par padti hai; unhen yaad hai ki Tae-Jun ne apni jawani, apni azadi aur apne shareer ka tyaag kar diya tha.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at chronos-malek with a fearless smile
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with radiant confidence: 'Take whatever memories you want. Just wake my brother up.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles with radiant confidence: 'Take whatever memories you want. Just wake my brother up.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ujjwal aatmavishwas ke saath muskurata hai: 'aap jo bhi yaadein chahte hain le len. bus mere bhai ko jaga do.'.

panels.shot: chronos-malek raising four golden scythe arms in judgment
panels.action: Chronos-Malek: 'First, you must prove your soul can bear the weight of time! Face the Wheel of Seconds!'
panels.prose_en: Chronos-Malek: 'First, you must prove your soul can bear the weight of time! Face the Wheel of Seconds!'.
panels.prose_hi: Cronos-malek: 'subse pahle, aapko yah sabit karna hoga ki aapki aatma samay ka bhaar sahan kar sakti hai! second ke pahiye ka samna karen!'

panels.shot: twelve giant clock hands detaching and flying as supersonic blades
panels.action: Twelve razor-sharp golden pendulum blades rocket across the platform like giant guillotine darts.
panels.prose_en: Twelve razor-sharp golden pendulum blades rocket across the platform like giant guillotine darts.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal gilotin darts ki tarah manch par barah rager-nukile sunhare pendulum blade rocket.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting chains of ruin in a defensive dome
panels.action: Ha-Jun summons Chains of Ruin, creating an impenetrable swirling sphere of black chain links around himself and Tae-Jun.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun summons Chains of Ruin, creating an impenetrable swirling sphere of black chain links around himself and Tae-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chains off ruin ko bulata hai, jisse wah apne aur Tae-Jun ke charon or kali chain kadiyon ka ek abhedy ghumta hua kshetra banata hai.

panels.shot: all twelve blades ricocheting off the adamantine chains
panels.action: Sparks rain in sheets as the clock hands bounce harmlessly off the gravitational ward.
panels.prose_en: Sparks rain in sheets as the clock hands bounce harmlessly off the gravitational ward.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi ghadi ki suiyan gurutvakarshan ward se hanirahit roop se ucchalti han, chadron mein chingariyan barsne lagti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping through the ceiling of his own chain dome
panels.action: Ha-Jun bursts through the top of his chain barrier, drawing both Sanguine Fang and the Bone Scythe in twin hands.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bursts through the top of his chain barrier, drawing both Sanguine Fang and the Bone Scythe in twin hands.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne chain barrier ke sheersh ko todta hai, aur senguin fang aur bone skith donon ko judwan hathon mein khinchta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun slicing through chronos-malek first two mechanical arms
panels.action: A flashing cross-slash of red blood-light and bone-white energy cleanly severs two of Chronos's golden arms.
panels.prose_en: A flashing cross-slash of red blood-light and bone-white energy cleanly severs two of Chronos's golden arms.
panels.prose_hi: Laal khoon-prakash aur asthi-shwet urja ka ek chamakta cross-slash chronos ki do sunhari bhujaon ko saaf kar deta hai.

panels.shot: chronos-malek rotating to skull face casting time-acceleration ray
panels.action: The skull mask rotates forward; a beam of grey time-decay magic shoots toward Ha-Jun to age him 100 years.
panels.prose_en: The skull mask rotates forward; a beam of grey time-decay magic shoots toward Ha-Jun to age him 100 years.
panels.prose_hi: Khopri ka mukhauta aage ki or ghumta hai; dhusar samay-kshay jadu ki ek kiran Ha-Jun ki or badhti hai jisse uski aayu 100 varsh ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting eclipse devourer eating the aging beam
panels.action: Ha-Jun manifests Eclipse Devourer, swallowing the decay ray whole and converting it into pure kinetic speed.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun manifests Eclipse Devourer, swallowing the decay ray whole and converting it into pure kinetic speed.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun grahan bhakshak ko prakat karta hai, kshay kiran ko pura nigalta hai aur ise shuddh gatij gati mein parivartit karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun appearing directly before chronos-malek central gear heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun materializes inches from Chronos-Malek's chest, right at the glowing crystal gear regulating the temporal nexus.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun materializes inches from Chronos-Malek's chest, right at the glowing crystal gear regulating the temporal nexus.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun cronos-malek ki chhati se kuch inch ki doori par, temporal nexus ko niyantrit karne wale chamakte crystal gear par sakar hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun driving blade into the gear heart cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives the Sanguine Fang straight through the temporal gear core, blinding the chamber in golden starlight!

dialogue.text: THE CLOCKWORK SHATTERS. THE HOURGLASS AWAKENS.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drives the Sanguine Fang straight through the temporal gear core, blinding the chamber in golden starlight!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun senguin feng ko temporal gear core ke madhyam se sidhe chalata hai, jisse chamber sunhari taron ki roshni mein chakachaundh ho jata hai!
